title: DecisionContext
description: Timer state and deadline budget for one decision (#678 §4.2). Relative durations only, never wall-clock time. Excluded by name from A1/A2 observation equality (ADR-008 §4).

timer_source.description: server: the server's own timer snapshot; shadow: Areneon's model of it (#678 §2.1).

turn_seconds_left.description: T: seconds left this turn at receipt.

bank_seconds_left.description: B: bank seconds left at receipt, grace excluded.

grace_seconds_left.description: G: grace seconds left at receipt; non-zero only at Team Preview.

remaining_decisions_estimate.description: R̂: estimated decisions left; battle only, omitted at Team Preview.

submit_within_ms.description: The choice must be sent within this, from receipt.

policy_budget_ms.description: The policy must answer within this; 0 means skip the policy and send the fallback.

TimerRules.description: The format's VGC Timer settings in whole seconds; they must equal the version manifest's.

grace.description: Grace time, spent only at Team Preview.

add_per_turn.description: Seconds added to the bank per turn.

max_first_turn.description: Cap on the first turn's time.
